{{Quote|Good job on getting the complete inventory. You need it get it to my slicer. But he is freelancing for some criminals. You need get to him, using any means necessary.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Jem Lavar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They are looking for a droid?<br />Yes. Didn't you know? Hmmm they must not have fully trusted you if they didn't tell you what they were actually looking for. Apparently this droid is carrying something extremely important.|A spacer and Jem Lavar|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Jem Lavar lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He worked as a freelance slicer for some criminals as well as for both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] were involved in the search of an important cargo smuggled to Tatooine from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. Rebel and Imperial agents acquired the inventory of the shipment and needed a slicer to get the data. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] then went to Jem Lavar and rescued him from a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunners]]. Lavar finally decrypted the data and discovered that both Barrezz and Bastra were actually looking for a droid that was sold to the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jam Lavar ''[sic]'' has the answers you need. Find him, and find the truth.|Narration|<ref name="TCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|cardname=Who Has the Button?}}</ref>}}
Jem Lavar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jem Lavar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

In the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' expansion ''[[Agents of Deception]]'', this character was erroneously identified as '''Jam Lavar''' on the card titled ''Who Has the Button?''.<ref name="TCG" />
